d:
Karva chauth ka parv pati-patni ke prem, vishvas aur samarpan ka pratik hai. is vishesh avsar par suhagin mahilaen apne pati ki lanbi aayu, sukhi danpaty jivan aur parivar ki khushhali ki kamna karte hue vrat rakhti hain.
Karva chauth ki paranprik rasmon, chand ke darshan aur tyohar ki khushiyon ke sath is madhur git ka aanand len aur apne priyajnon ke sath karva chauth ki khushiyan banten.
Karwa Chauth Geet: Saans Jab Tak Rahe Main Suhagan Rahun
Singer: Menka Mishra
Music Director: Narender Tripati
Lyricist: Surjit Kumar Tripati
Album: Maiya Ka Darbar Saza Hai
Music Label: T-Series
